subject: english
stem: Pick the sentence that accurately states the audience data.
options: No one attended the Pop program.
Pop drew 65 people, more than Folk or Jazz.
Folk and Pop each drew 50 people.

optionRationales.reason: No one attended the Pop program.：與 65 相反。
Pop drew 65 people, more than Folk or Jazz.：Pop 65 高於 Folk 50 與 Jazz 35。
Jazz drew the largest audience.：Jazz 最低。
Folk and Pop each drew 50 people.：Pop 是 65。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 先遮住選項，依「英文句中的主詞、比較方向、數值與範圍全部對應圖表」可推出 Pop drew 65 people, more than Folk or Jazz.；再核對題面每個線索，答案索引一致。
把四個選項逐一代回原文，只有 Pop drew 65 people, more than Folk or Jazz. 能同時滿足句法與全文意思；另外三項各有明確衝突，沒有第二答案。
